name: Top High Image Corp.
summary: Top High Image Corp., headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, functions as a global producer and vendor of printing plates and various associated consumables. Its extensive product range features a diverse selection of TOP offset printing plates, such as the T-20 Process Free, T-UV Thermal CTP, T-830 Positive Thermal CTP, HS-920 Positive UV CTP, TP-103 Positive Conventional PS, and HD-UV thermal CTP plates. The company also supplies Durst brand items, including the TAU 330 RSC, TAU 330 RSC E, and TAURSci. Additional offerings include synthetic papers, the SCODIX Ultra Series, and SeiLASER products like Paper One 5000, Mercury 1520, and Label Master 600. Furthermore, they provide hot stamping and cold foils, thermal CTP plate processors, wash cloths, and UV over printing varnishes. Beyond its core operations, the corporation extends its activities into trading and various services, food manufacturing and wholesale, advertising, and real estate agency. Founded in 1995, the entity was originally known as Top Aluminum Co., Ltd. before rebranding as Top High Image Corp. in July 2000.
